description: Beegait's Claude-side belt (card MV2-11): three PreToolUse guards, each a stdlib Python script that reads the tool input on stdin and refuses with exit 2 — never force-push (the account's Security rule), never edit inside a card's 📝 Request section (the manager's verbatim words), never set a card to Done (the manager accepts on the board). Launched through hooks/run.sh by NAME (every exec line literal, from ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} — the directory's scan rule): `python` else `python3`; with neither, one loud stderr line on every tool call (the belt is OFF, never silently).
